label: Workspace Switcher
description: Navigation with a workspace switcher. Best for an inset panel whose header menu switches the workspace named in the screen's breadcrumb, beside placeholder cards.

label: Icon Rail
description: Icon rail that collapses. Best for narrowing the panel to icons while the brand tile stays in view, toggled by a header or footer button.

label: Docs Navigation
description: Docs navigation with sub-menus. Best for a panel where typing opens every section that still matches, with the current page's section open on load.

label: Inspector Panel
description: Inspector panel. Best for issue details in a sheet from the right: assignees with owner and remove actions, linked work, an activity feed and an Open in board button.

label: Filter & Loading
description: Filtering, loading and empty states. Best for a project list whose pinned rows survive any query, with a refresh spinner, a clear button in the search and a plan usage footer.
